module rtlpp_06341 (
	clk,
	in1,
	saida_mealy
);
input 	clk;
input 	in1;
output 	saida_mealy;

wire gnd;
wire vcc;
wire unknown;

assign gnd = 1'b0;
assign vcc = 1'b1;
assign unknown = 1'bx;

tri1 devclrn;
tri1 devpor;
tri1 devoe;

reg present_state_temp;
reg present_state_febre;
reg present_state_base_dados;

wire Selector0_combout = !in1 & !present_state_base_dados;
wire next_state_febre_combout = !in1 & !present_state_temp;
wire Selector1_combout = !in1 & !present_state_febre;
wire saida_mealy_combout = !in1 & !present_state_base_dados;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    present_state_temp <= Selector0_combout;
    present_state_febre <= next_state_febre_combout;
    present_state_base_dados <= Selector1_combout;
end

assign saida_mealy = saida_mealy_combout;

endmodule
